task_description: Full reports module for OrientApp admin panel: extract reports into ReportsClient.tsx component, add Dashboard view with summary cards and CSS bar charts, and 6 filterable sub-reports (Por Usuario, Por Área, Por Grupo, Por Fecha, Por Carrera, Por Método) each with CSV export capability. Print/PDF export for dashboard. All text in Spanish. No new external npm deps.

verification.summary: 152 Vitest tests green (15 files), tsc --noEmit clean, next lint 0 warnings/errors, no-env build succeeds. 2-pass review cycle: v1 found AreaTab char-splitting for TIPOV/CIPR/MAGDALENA (fixed) and CHASIDE label collision in ALL view (fixed in commit f7c7135). v2 rendered APPROVED with 2 non-blocking notes: deleted-cohort sessions have no GrupoTab filter option (cosmetic), and SIN GRUPO sentinel label in Dashboard group comparison (cosmetic). All 7 report sub-tabs shipped: Dashboard (4 stat cards + CSS bar charts + RIASEC dimension avgs + group comparison + print button), Por Usuario (search+table+CSV), Por Área (method-aware frequency bars with proper RIASEC/CHASIDE labels + CSV), Por Grupo (cohort selector + RIASEC avgs + CSV), Por Fecha (date range + timeline bars + CSV), Por Carrera (RIASEC career distribution + CSV), Por Método (per-method cards + CSV). All CSV exports use UTF-8 BOM.
